Ana (PM): Quick alignment thread 14: we got a new ask from two pilot customers to push embeddings into MVP. This collides with our v1 model-pinning effort. Need scope decision.
Ravi (Eng): Can you summarize the constraints?
Priya (CS): Customers expect nightly bulk jobs and interactive lookup latency similar to our current hosted p50. They9re comfortable paying for reserved capacity if needed.
Omar (Infra): FYI0: we9re short on Dedicated GPU slots during next maintenance window; autoscale will cover spikes but sustained nightly will backlog.
Jo (Data): Also note: the v1 model pin requires extra quantization QA and could add 2 weeks to model onboarding.
Ana (PM): Options I see: A) include embeddings in MVP but limit to pilot orgs behind reservation B) move embeddings to v1 and ship MVP without bulk uploads C) partial scope: interactive embeddings only, bulk delayed. Thoughts?
Ravi (Eng): A keeps customer experience intact but increases ops and cost commitments. C feels like a lower-risk compromise.
Priya (CS): Pilots prefer A but will accept C if we commit a timeline for bulk. They want clear SLA for interactive path.
Linh (Design): If we do C, we should hide upload UX and show "coming in v1 (pilot available)" microcopy to manage expectations.
Omar (Infra): For A we can carve out reserved windows: 2 GPUs nightly from 02:00-06:00 UTC for pilot orgs. Needs Dedicated config + routing rule. I estimate 48 hours lead to provision and test.
Ravi (Eng): Implementation plan for A: org-gated feature flag + routing -> Dedicated pool. Fallback to quantized on overflow. Rough work: flag (1d), routing + tests (2d), canary (1d).
Jo (Data): Fallback model will increase p50 but keeps throughput. We should add quality regression checks to the pipeline.
Ana (PM): Acceptance criteria if we pick A: - Pilot orgs can run up to 8M tokens/night - Interactive p50 <=250ms - Monitor and alerts for queue >60% - Contracted reserved capacity by pilot sign-off.
Priya (CS): I can get verbal confirmation today; legal needs written commit before we bill.
Ravi (Eng): If we pick C instead: remove batch upload from public MVP, keep single request endpoints, no infra reservations. That unblocks release but pushes bulk feature to v1 slot.
Omar (Infra): C reduces short-term infra work. However we still need to finalize model pin timing for v1 or risk rework.
Ana (PM): We9re at a milestone decision: do we shift launch date or keep current date and shrink scope? Input: product/marketing already committed to the current ship window.
Priya (CS): Customers want pilot this week if possible. If we shrink scope, pilots might be unhappy.
Ravi (Eng): Proposal: hybrid: ship MVP to public without bulk uploads (C) but enable pilot-only bulk via reservation (A) gated behind org flag. This reduces public risk and keeps pilots happy.
Linh (Design): Agree. UX: add "Pilot: bulk uploads enabled" banner inside org settings.
Jo (Data): Need to lock in dataset quotas and nightly window. Suggest 02:00-06:00 UTC with soft cap alerts.
Ana (PM): Decision logged: Hybrid approach. Action items and owners incoming.
Ravi (Eng): I'll scope PRs: feature flag + routing + fallback tests. ETA 3 days.
Omar (Infra): I'll provision Dedicated carve-out and add dashboards. ETA 2 days.
Linh (Design): I'll prepare the microcopy and hidden UI elements. ETA 1 day.
Priya (CS): I'll confirm pilots and capture commitment for reserved capacity; target to get signed MOU by EOD +2.
Ana (PM): Milestone tracking: update milestone board -> MVP ship (public) on schedule; pilot reserved launch gated by signed MOU. If MOU misses EOD+2, we auto-disable pilot bulk and notify customers.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prod/mvp-ui-hide-bulk -> staging at 2147600035
Ravi (Eng): Noted staging deploy. Will post canary metrics here.
Jo (Data): I'll add a data smoke test to simulate nightly ingest and assert queue <50% under reserved carve.
Omar (Infra): Dashboard panels: queue depth, token/sec, reserved slot utilization, p50/p95. Alert at >50% queue.
Ana (PM): OK team. I'll update roadmap doc and milestone board. Reopen thread if legal or capacity changes. :thumbsup:
